answer_1.quote: Text-to-SQL systems generate SQL queries according to given natural language questions.

answer_2.quote: Two metrics in Zhong et al. (2018) are adopt for evaluating the SQL query synthesis accuracy: (1) Logical Form Accuracy, denoted as LF , where LF = # of SQL queries with correct logic form / total # of SQL queries; and (2) Execution Accuracy, denoted as EX, where EX = # of SQL queries with correct execution / total # of SQL queries.
